• In order to offer this service, Temenos needs your approval to access through its trusted partners Salt Edge Inc. the following information from the account you hold.
• Your Account Details. (Account Name, Number and Sort Code, Card Number, Balances etc.)
•Your Account Transactions. (Incoming or Outgoing transaction details from 90 days, statement details, etc.)
The above information may be updated several times a day when you are offline. The Consent to Access that you are giving will be valid until deletion of the access connection.
